title.zh: Breaking the 1.58-bit Barrier for Ternary LLMs
title.en: Breaking the 1.58-bit Barrier for Ternary LLMs

current_state.zh: A new arXiv paper breaks the 1.58-bit barrier for ternary LLMs by exploiting the empirical sparsity of zero weights to reach ~1.48 bits per weight, with HN commenters debating its merits versus vector/trellis quantization and its potential for ASIC and embedded deployment.
